entity-dedup.title: Entity deduplication: fix ingestion dedup + retroactive cleanup of existing duplicates
entity-dedup.notes: Entity extraction cron creates duplicate nodes for people/orgs that already exist (e.g. two 'Dylan Patel' nodes: guest 3129 and entity 4212). Dedup search doesn't match across node types or handle name variations. Fix dedup at ingestion time (broader search, normalized matching, cross-type), then run retroactive scan to find and merge all existing duplicates.

tasks.text: Step 1: Fix entity dedup at ingestion (cross-type search, name normalization, multi-strategy matching)
Step 2: Add pre-creation confirmation (threshold matching, pick canonical by edge count)
Step 3: Retroactive dedup scan script (find dupes, merge edges, delete duplicates)

paper-club-paper-queue.title: Paper Club re-engagement — simple Hub + Slop loop for volunteers, prereading, and organizer signal
paper-club-paper-queue.notes: Expand the Paper Club idea into a simple, high-leverage community feedback and Discord re-engagement loop. Current state: Slop can schedule Paper Club presenters and send reminders, but almost nobody uses the flow. Organizers mainly need a healthy presenter pipeline: members should feel encouraged to volunteer, should have enough context to do a good job, and should see Paper Club as an ongoing conversation rather than a one-hour meeting. Explore the smallest Hub + Slop update that captures paper interest, prompts lightweight pre-session discussion, surfaces good presenter candidates, and helps organizers see what the community wants next. Keep this at ideation/PRD level for now; avoid prescribing a specific implementation until the strongest simple loop is chosen.

tasks.text: Step 1: Clarify the core re-engagement loop for Paper Club attendees and organizers
Step 2: Ideate the smallest useful Hub + Slop experience that encourages volunteers and prereading
Step 3: Identify what organizers need to see to confidently recruit presenters
Step 4: Convert the best idea into a narrow implementation PRD with acceptance criteria and non-goals
